title: record chrome draws the record's picture from the object's `imageField` in the record page header — the renderer half of objectstack#21182 (ruling A on hotcrm#1199)
body:
Unblocked: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21182 closed completed through PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21221 (`9969228626`), and the fix is installable in `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 (hold released in the comment below).

Filed by the director seat, summon #32, objectstack-ai/objectstack `session_016tKoy8NJa35Yih1FdzrVmn`, as the renderer half of the maintainer's ruling **A** on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1199. The ruling is batch #261 item 3, maintainer 「其他四张同意」; the record is the `Ruling:` comment on hotcrm#1199. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What to build

- The record chrome draws the record's picture beside the title, from the field the object names in its new object-level `imageField` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21182). The chrome lives in `page:header`'s `PageHeaderRenderer`, `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, the record branch at about `:2157`–`:2194` on `main` `8001068b9c`.
- The value comes from the served row. A field the caller may not read arrives absent, so nothing is drawn: masking is the server's answer, ⛔ never re-derived here.
- No declaration, or an empty value, draws nothing. ⛔ No initials/placeholder avatar (ruled out, zero pull).
- `recordChrome: false` keeps today's bare header.
- ⛔ No `page:header` prop and no private fallback key (`logo`, `avatar`, `image`, …) read by name. The object declaration is the only channel.

## Unlock

- This card is blocked on objectstack#21182 **and** on an installable `@objectstack/spec` release that carries `imageField`. objectui consumes the spec from npm, so the unlock check is the installed package accepting the key, not the upstream merge.
- Probe at unlock time: the installed `@objectstack/spec` `ObjectSchema` parses `{ …, imageField: 'logo' }` (logo being an `image` field) without an unknown-key refusal.

## Acceptance

- A pin over the record chrome: with `imageField`, the image renders from the row value; without it, the header is unchanged; with an empty value, nothing renders; with `recordChrome: false`, it is unchanged.
- A changeset for the released package.
- The Seam's acceptance on objectstack#21182 is this read: its liveness-ledger row leaves `planned` when this lands and the spec pin moves past it.
- The first app reader is hotcrm#1199 (`crm_account.logo`), which waits on this card.

## Lane

`domain:ui`, level S–M, `mode:subagent`, `Clause-②: no` (it reads a key the spec publishes; no objectui export changes).

Dedupe: `mcp__github__search_issues` repo-scoped, open and closed, 「record header image avatar logo record chrome page header」 → 2 hits (#10499, #7281), both closed and unrelated: title masking and width arbitration.
